title: Shape the invitation page
question: Three new layouts drawn from the Cinderella story, in your invitation's blue, gold and cream. Choose one for the phone.

options.label: The Palace Portrait Hall
options.lineage: the palace ballroom, its chandelier and gilded royal portraits
options.thesis: Arrive at the ball: under a chandelier hangs the princess's gilded portrait, and its brass plaque holds the party details and the RSVP.
options.viewport: Chandelier glow, ONE-derful, Amaris's portrait in a gold frame, and a plaque with date, time, venue and the RSVP button.
options.risk: The frame must stay light and bright; heavy gilt on dark walls turns into a museum, not a first birthday.

options.label: The Pumpkin Carriage
options.lineage: the fairy godmother's pumpkin carriage on its way to the ball
options.thesis: Ride to the ball: guests look out of the carriage's oval window at Amaris, and the details sit on the carriage door.
options.viewport: Velvet curtains frame an oval window with her photo; below, the carriage door carries the details, RSVP, directions and calendar.
options.risk: The curtains and frame must not crowd the photo on a small phone.

options.label: Before the Clock Strikes
options.lineage: the palace clock that every Cinderella story turns on
options.thesis: The countdown is the hero: a great palace clock counts down to 6:00 PM on November 22, with the glass slipper waiting below.
options.viewport: A large clock face reading 17 days to the ball, ONE-derful and Amaris above, the details and RSVP in the clock case below.
options.risk: The countdown can upstage her photos; the photos need a strong second screen.
